method.selection_policy: LLM-selected market-relevant items from news_digest.json; preserves source metadata and excludes noise.

framework.Equities: Broad equity/risk sentiment; market-moving mega-cap/AI allowed; low-signal single-stock noise excluded.
framework.Commodities: Physical commodity futures framework; supply disruption/demand strength positive; supply increase/demand weakness negative.
framework.FX: USD-centric basket; non-USD currency strength positive; USD/DXY strength negative.
framework.Rates: Bond-price framework; yields up/selloff/higher-for-longer negative; yields down/bond rally/cooler inflation positive.

Equities.title: Wall Street indexes dip with technology earnings, rising oil in focus
Equities.reason: Broad U.S. market weakness tied to technology earnings and rising oil — reinforces a market regime where AI capex and energy-driven inflation risk push sentiment toward cautious/negative for equities.

Equities.title: Stocks Fall as AI Spending Fears Grow, Oil Rises: Markets Wrap
Equities.reason: Headlines link growing AI spending concerns with rising oil — a dual pressure on valuations (tech capex fears) and macro (input/cost/inflation worries) that leans toward risk-off in equities.

Equities.title: Alphabet and Tesla test Wall Street's patience as AI spending overshadows growth
Equities.summary: Shares of Alphabet and Tesla dipped after the companies reported massive spending increases in their quarterly earnings reports.
Equities.reason: Earnings from two AI/tech leaders show massive spending increases; this is a high-signal story for the market regime — investor patience tested and sector leadership being re-priced due to capex.

Equities.title: Tesla misses on earnings, as free cash flow turns negative and margins slide
Equities.summary: Tesla's earnings report lands in the midst of a slide in the company's stock price even as its core auto business is rebounding.
Equities.reason: Idiosyncratic large-cap earnings miss with negative free cash flow and margin pressure — directly weighs on market sentiment given Tesla's index weighting and AI/EV thematic exposure.

Equities.title: Google burns through $6bn in cash as AI spending climbs again
Equities.summary: Search giant says it will commit up to $205bn to AI investments in 2026
Equities.reason: Major-capex commitment ($205bn) from a market leader is a structural story that amplifies concerns over profit trade-offs and investor tolerance for heavy AI investment — a high-relevance negative for broad equities risk sentiment.

Equities.title: Asian Chip Stocks Climb as Alphabet Spending Revives AI Momentum
Equities.reason: Sector-specific positive: AI-related capex news lifts chip names and suggests rotation into hardware beneficiaries. Relevant as a constructive counter-signal but lower relevance versus market-wide capex/inflation concerns.

Equities.title: S&P 500 Slumps for Fourth Time in Five Days as Oil Prices Jump
Equities.reason: Persistent index weakness tied to oil-driven costs and big-tech earnings — reinforces the dominant negative market narrative (risk-off, earnings/ capex as a headwind).

Rates.title: Stock Market News, July 22, 2026: New Climb in Oil Prices Sends Bond Yields Near 2026 Highs
Rates.reason: Headline links rising oil and higher global bond yields -> bond sell-off / higher-for-longer rate narrative. Market-wide impact makes this a negative signal for bond prices (yields up).

Rates.title: What Surging Bond Yields Mean for Consumers and Markets
Rates.reason: Analyst/consumer-facing explanation of rising yields and implications; reinforces the dominant higher-yields narrative (negative for bond prices).

Rates.title: The Treasury market touches a worrying milestone not seen since 2007
Rates.reason: Suggests market functioning / liquidity stress in the Treasury market at a critical juncture — negative for bond market risk sentiment and amplifies selloff concerns.

Rates.title: China Bond Rally Shows Weak Economic Sentiment Before Politburo
Rates.reason: Local bond rally implies falling yields in China driven by weak growth/outlook — positive for bond prices domestically and a partial counterpoint to global hawkish moves.

Rates.title: Australian Employment Soars in June, Bolstering Rate-Hike Bets
Rates.reason: Stronger employment lifts RBA rate-hike expectations -> local yields likely to rise; reinforces global tightening narrative (negative for bond prices).

Rates.title: BoJ to raise rates again by December — Reuters poll
Rates.summary: According to a majority of economists in a Reuters poll, the Bank of Japan (BoJ) will raise its interest rate again by the end of December and possibly as soon as October, keeping further rate rises in view through next year.
Rates.reason: Poll-based expectations of further BoJ tightening imply higher JGB yields and a potentially wider global rates repricing — negative for bond prices.

Rates.title: Japan awakes
Rates.summary: Why 1 per cent interest rates could shake everything up after a generation of deflation
Rates.reason: Analysis piece arguing that higher Japanese rates (toward 1%) would be market-moving and could unsettle global bond markets — supports higher-for-longer narrative (negative for bonds).

FX.title: European Central Bank set to hold interest rates amid cooling inflation and weaker growth
FX.summary: The European Central Bank (ECB) is expected to hold the interest rate on the main refinancing operations and the deposit facility steady at 2.4% and 2.25%, respectively. The decision will be announced on Thursday at 12:15 GMT.
FX.reason: ECB expected to hold amid cooling inflation and weaker growth is a material EUR/USD driver; leans dovish for the euro versus the dollar. Central-bank decision has elevated FX relevance.

FX.title: EUR/USD Price Forecast: Reflects strength ahead of ECB’s policy decision
FX.summary: The Euro (EUR) is up 0.15% at around 1.1430 against the US Dollar (USD) during the early European trading session on Thursday. The EUR/USD pair rises as the major currency outperforms its peers ahead of the European Central Bank’s (ECB) monetary policy announc
FX.reason: Short-term EURUSD technical/price note showing modest euro strength ahead of ECB; treated as price-forecast/technical with capped relevance.

FX.title: Canadian Dollar gains traction on rising oil prices as US-Iran war escalates
FX.summary: The USD/CAD pair attracts some sellers to near 1.4060 during the early European trading hours on Thursday. A rise in crude oil prices provides some support to the commodity-linked Canadian Dollar (CAD) against the US Dollar (USD).
FX.reason: Geopolitical escalation lifting oil and supporting CAD is a direct USD/CAD flow driver; commodity-linked FX move with clear transmission to the pair.

FX.title: Euro: Hawkish ECB stance to limit downside against US Dollar – ING
FX.summary: ING’s Francesco Pesole expects the ECB to leave rates unchanged but deliver a hawkish hold, with Middle East tensions and rising European gas prices keeping hawks in control.
FX.reason: Bank commentary signalling a 'hawkish hold' is supportive for the euro versus the dollar and limits downside; central-bank stance commentary has meaningful FX impact.

FX.title: US Dollar Index Price Forecast: Weakens to near 101.00, but retains bullish tone above 100-day SMA
FX.summary: The US Dollar Index (DXY), an index of the value of the US Dollar (USD) measured against a basket of six world currencies, currently trades near 101.00 in the early European trading hours on Thursday. The DXY weakens amid improved risk sentiment.
FX.reason: DXY weakening is a key cross-market signal (USD down) — high relevance for FX flows and broad risk transmission.

FX.title: Japanese Yen: Further losses toward 163.50 against US Dollar – UOB
FX.summary: United Overseas Bank’s Quek Ser Leang and Lee Sue Ann note after USD/JPY hit a 40‑year high above 163, now expect intraday consolidation between 162.80 and 163.30 as recent price action offers few fresh clues.
FX.reason: USD/JPY at 40-year highs is a major USD-strength/JPY-weakness signal with intervention risk; high relevance for FX markets.

FX.title: US-Iran tensions underpin dollar as yen nears 40-year low
FX.reason: Major geopolitical story cited by Reuters: Middle East tensions supporting the dollar and pressuring the yen — strong macro FX driver (USD strength).

FX.title: Indian Rupee attracts slight bids on possible RBI’s intervention
FX.summary: The Indian Rupee (INR) opens marginally higher against the US Dollar (USD) on Thursday on possible Reserve Bank of India (RBI) intervention in spot and non-deliverable forwards (NDFs) markets to support the currency.
FX.reason: Possible central-bank intervention to support INR is a direct FX flow signal for USD/INR and NDFs; intervention talk raises relevance.

FX.title: Indonesian Rupiah steadies as traders weigh BI’s decision of holding rates
FX.summary: USD/IDR moves little after posting minor gains in the previous day, trading around 17,960 during the Asian hours on Thursday. The pair steadies as the Indonesian Rupiah (IDR) strengthens following Bank Indonesia's (BI) surprise decision to hold benchmark rates
FX.reason: Bank Indonesia holding rates and IDR steadiness is a direct EMFX driver; relevant to regional FX flows but more local in scope.

FX.title: Japanese Yen edges higher amid intervention risks; remains close to four-decade low vs USD
FX.summary: The USD/JPY pair ticks lower during the Asian session on Thursday as bulls opt to move to the sidelines amid speculations that Japanese authorities will step in to prop up the domestic currency.
FX.reason: Short-covering/official intervention speculation gives the yen temporary support; important as a counter-signal to USD/JPY moves but lower relevance than primary USD-strength stories.

FX.title: AUD/USD Price Forecast: Looks to build on upbeat Aussie jobs data-led gains above 0.7000
FX.summary: The AUD/USD pair catches fresh bids during the Asian session on Thursday following the release of the upbeat Australian jobs report, which lifted bets for another interest rate hike by the Reserve Bank of Australia (RBA).
FX.reason: Stronger Australian jobs data lifting AUD vs USD is a direct FX catalyst; treated as price-forecast/technical with capped relevance.

Commodities.title: Silver Price Forecasts: XAG/USD stalls below $60 as US yields rally
Commodities.summary: Silver (XAG/USD) is trading practically flat, a few cents below the $60.00 level on Thursday, with upside attempts capped as US Treasury yields jump to fresh highs.
Commodities.reason: Rising US yields are a headwind for precious metals; this note is a direct market-price transmission (silver weak on yield move).

Commodities.title: Oil: Middle East tensions raise supply risks – MUFG
Commodities.summary: Lloyd Chan at MUFG underscores escalating US–Iran tensions and threats to energy infrastructure and shipping through the Strait of Hormuz and Bab el-Mandeb.
Commodities.reason: Direct supply-risk commentary from a bank strategist — reinforces oil upside via higher risk premium and shipping/infrastructure threat.

Commodities.title: John Paulson says we are in the early stages of a long-term bull market for gold
Commodities.summary: He said demand for bullion continues to broaden, led by central banks that have been adding to their reserves alongside growing private-sector interest.
Commodities.reason: High-profile bullish view stressing central-bank demand broadening — supportive fundamental narrative for gold but opinion-based, moderate relevance.

Commodities.title: Gold Holds Gain as Dip-Buying Counters Inflation Fears From War
Commodities.reason: Market-price piece linking gold strength to war-driven inflation/fear — supports safe-haven demand and price resilience narrative.

Commodities.title: Petroleum markets responded to disruptions in the Middle East in the second quarter
Commodities.summary: Petroleum markets in the second quarter of 2026 (2Q26) were characterized by continued disruptions to international crude oil and petroleum product flows through the Strait of Hormuz, contributing to higher and more volatile crude oil prices through most of th
Commodities.reason: EIA analysis documenting actual supply-flow disruptions — fundamental support for higher and more volatile oil prices (supply shock evidence).

Commodities.title: Commercial crude oil inventories increased by 2.0 million barrels
Commodities.summary: For the week ending July 17, 2026, commercial crude oil inventories (excluding the Strategic Petroleum Reserve) increased 2.0 million barrels to 411.7 million barrels, 6% below the previous five-year (2021–2025) average. Gasoline inventories increased 0.8 mill
Commodities.reason: Inventory build is a conventional near-term bearish data point for oil — offsets some geopolitical upside risk but magnitude is moderate.

Commodities.title: India Silver Imports Slump as New Licensing Disrupts Shipments
Commodities.reason: Supply disruption in a major physical market (India) is a supportive fundamental for silver prices — direct commodity transmission, medium relevance.

Commodities.title: Oil prices rise to six-week high as US-Iran tensions escalate
Commodities.reason: Market headline: prices moving materially higher on geopolitical escalation — strong direct signal for oil upside and risk-premium repricing.

Commodities.title: Brent: Energy risk premium rises – RaboResearch
Commodities.summary: Rabobank strategist Michael Every warns that escalating conflict around Hormuz and the Red Sea could push Brent above its current USD 95.5 level and widen crack spreads further.
Commodities.reason: Analyst call highlighting rising energy risk premium — reinforces bullish Brent narrative and crack-spread implications (refinery margins).

Commodities.title: Houthis claim strikes on Saudi Arabian oil tankers in Red Sea as Iran conflict expands
Commodities.summary: Yemen's Houthis said they had targeted two Saudi Arabian oil tankers with drones and missiles for allegedly violating its maritime blockade.
Commodities.reason: Direct attack claims on tankers threaten flows through the Red Sea/Bab el-Mandeb — clear supply-risk event with high market relevance for oil.

Commodities.title: Oil jumps to $98 after Houthis attack two Saudi Arabian oil tankers
Commodities.summary: Yemeni rebels say they used missiles and drones to target the vessels Encelia and Layla
Commodities.reason: Priced market reaction tied to a concrete attack on shipping — strong, high-relevance bullish shock to oil through heightened supply-risk premium.

Commodities.title: Brent Crude Spikes in Late Trading After Red Sea Tanker Attack
Commodities.reason: Market-price move directly linked to tanker attack — reinforces the dominant commodity narrative of heightened oil risk-premium.

Commodities.title: Global liquefied natural gas trade volumes reached record high in 2025
Commodities.summary: Global liquefied natural gas (LNG) trade volumes increased 5.4% to a record 56.3 billion cubic feet per day last year (Bcf/d), driven largely by U.S. LNG export capacity expanding to meet growing demand, according to a recent report from the International Grou
Commodities.reason: Record LNG trade volumes point to structurally stronger natural gas flows/demand from rising US export capacity — supportive but not immediate price shock.

Commodities.title: Silver and gold prices stage a cautious rebound — but analysts see slim hopes for a sustained rally
Commodities.summary: Precious metals have rallied in recent days, but analysts say prices could face a difficult path back to all-time highs achieved earlier this year.
Commodities.reason: Market-tone piece noting short-term rebound but constrained upside — limited relevance for durable directional thesis.

Crypto.title: Bitcoin wilts as oil and rates rise. Clarity Act odds tumble to 38%
Crypto.reason: Combines macro pressure (rising rates/oil) that typically hurts crypto risk assets with reduced odds for a regulatory clarity bill — a double negative for market sentiment and positioning.

Crypto.title: Balance stablecoin collapses 99% after $1 million exploit drains its bitcoin vaults
Crypto.reason: Severe stablecoin failure following an exploit directly undermines trust in on-chain dollar proxies — large, high-relevance downside for crypto market plumbing and risk appetite.

Crypto.title: Bitcoin, Ethereum-linked protocols lose $35 million in multiple attacks hours apart
Crypto.reason: Multiple attacks and sizable losses amplify security concerns across major protocol ecosystems, weighing on market confidence and flows into risk assets.

Crypto.title: SecondFi to shut down after $2.4 million ADA wallet theft
Crypto.reason: Project shutdown after a wallet theft highlights operational/security risks in web3, negative for developer/retailer confidence and token holder sentiment.

Crypto.title: Popular crypto firm files for Chapter 11 after token collapse
Crypto.reason: Corporate insolvency following a token collapse is a material credit/ecosystem event that increases counterparty risk and reduces investor willingness to hold crypto exposure.

Crypto.title: SEC's Peirce warns some DeFi vaults, onchain lending may fall under securities laws
Crypto.reason: Regulatory signals that DeFi products could be securities raise compliance risk and potential restructuring of major on-chain lending primitives — net negative for the sector.

Crypto.title: Bitcoin retreats from one-month high as oil tops $85, inflation concerns resurface
Crypto.reason: Macro headlines around higher oil and inflation correlate with risk-off moves in bitcoin; a modest, market-momentum negative signal.

Crypto.title: South Korea's oldest crypto exchange is now part of the $1 trillion Mirae Group family
Crypto.reason: Acquisition by a major financial conglomerate signals institutionalization and deeper capital backing for crypto infrastructure — supportive for longer-term adoption and liquidity.

Crypto.title: Forget Nvidia: The next big AI trade could be crypto and blockchain
Crypto.reason: Positive narrative linking AI/crypto synergy could drive investor interest and capital allocation into blockchain projects tied to AI — constructive for demand.

Crypto.title: U.S. seeks forfeiture of $25 million in crypto tied to romance and investment scams
Crypto.reason: Enforcement action highlights ongoing legal/regulatory pressure and illicit-asset tracking — negative for perception of crypto risks, though it also supports rule-of-law.
